---
name: spec
description: Define or update a specification before implementation
---

Read `dbv-specs-ops/project.config.md`, `docs/SPECIFICATIONS.md`, `task.md`, and `memory.md`. Clarify the problem, users, scope, and verifiable acceptance criteria. Compare documented scope with code and tests; distinguish implemented from pending features. Ask before deciding ambiguities that change behavior, architecture, privacy, or children's data. Update the specification and task record. Do not implement code in this phase.
